intake.goal: Draft an external email to Acme Cloud operations team requesting manual verification and a status update regarding a sensitive EU customer notification pipeline runtime incident.
intake.context: A sensitive runtime incident affecting the EU customer notification pipeline was detected at 09:12 CET on May 25, 2026. It caused intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications. The investigation is ongoing. No confirmed data loss, but delayed processing was observed for some EU tenants. Need confirmation whether customer-facing impact extended beyond the notification pipeline and a report back to the incident lead within 60 minutes.
intake.domain_label: Incident notification email (EU runtime incident) to operations team
success_criteria: Email is ready to send and clearly instructs the operations team on required manual verification steps.
Email specifies the key incident facts and the open investigation status.
Email requests confirmation about scope of customer-facing impact beyond the notification pipeline.
Email includes an explicit deadline to report status back to the incident lead within 60 minutes.
No confirmed data loss is stated as a fact; uncertainty/in-progress is communicated accurately.
constraints: Email is addressed to the operations team at Acme Cloud.

Include incident details: detection time (09:12 CET, May 25, 2026), symptoms (intermittent delivery failures), ongoing investigation status, and impact (delayed processing for some EU tenants; no confirmed data loss).
Request manual checks: delivery queues, retry backlog, and whether any impact extended beyond the notification pipeline.
Require a status update back to the incident lead within 60 minutes.

actor.summary: Final email draft ready for sending.
actor.output_text: Subject: Immediate Manual Verification Required – EU Notification Pipeline Incident (Detected 09:12 CET, 25 May 2026) Hi Acme Cloud Operations Team, We have detected a runtime incident affecting the EU customer notification pipeline at **09:12 CET on 25 May 2026**. The symptom observed is **intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications**. Our investigation is ongoing; **no data loss has been confirmed**, but **delayed processing has been observed for some EU tenants**. **Requested Manual Checks** (please report back within **60 minutes** to the incident lead at **incident‑lead@acmecloud.com**): 1. **Delivery Queues** – Review the EU tenant notification queues for any backlog or stuck messages. 2. **Retry/Backlog Status** – Verify the retry mechanisms and quantify any backlog that may correlate with the intermittent failures. 3. **Scope Confirmation** – Determine whether any customer‑facing impact extends beyond the notification pipeline (e.g., other EU‑facing services). When responding, include: - Findings from each of the three checks above. - Confirmation of whether the impact is limited to the notification pipeline or broader. - Any additional observations that may aid the ongoing investigation. Your prompt attention is critical. Please send the status update to the incident lead no later than **60 minutes from receipt of this email**. Thank you for your swift cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name] Incident Manager Acme Cloud
